ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by a dominant low-intensity (black/dark grey) background with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixel clusters concentrated on distal margins and the peduncle axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black pigmentation occupies the central regions of both lobes; dendritic white mottling and streaks radiate from the trailing edges toward the interior; high-intensity vertical column present along the center-line peduncle region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute, narrow V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 35-40 degrees, penetrating deeply toward the fluke base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular, high-frequency serrations across the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude variations are most extreme at the distal tips where organic encrustations create jagged protrusions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave sweep from the median notch, transitioning to a convex curve leading to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters present on the extreme distal tips of both lobes, consistent with localized barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible vertical and diagonal light-colored linear streaks disrupting the dark pigmentation on the interior surface of both lobes, notably on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological encrustation (barnacles) localized on the outer distal edges of both fluke lobes, causing significant deviation from a smooth geometric edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a secondary marine mammal (pinniped) head visible in the background water at the bottom right quadrant of the image frame.
